name: Isopropyl linoleate
description: Isopropyl linoleate ( CAS 22882-95-7 ), also known by the trade name Ceraphyl IPL, is the isopropyl ester of linoleic acid used as an emollient, solvent, and carrier in personal care and pharmaceutical formulations. It delivers a lightweight, non-greasy skin feel while supporting the dispersion and delivery of active ingredients. Formulators source it primarily for its compatibility with a broad range of cosmetic raw materials. In skin care and body care products, it functions as an emollient and moisturizing agent, improving skin softness without the heavy residue associated with heavier esters or oils. It acts as a solvent and carrier for UV filters, fragrance components, and lipophilic actives in sunscreens, serums, and leave-on treatments. This versatility makes it a staple in modern cosmetic chemistry. Pharmaceutical topical formulations use it to enhance the spreadability and skin absorption of active drug substances in creams and ointments. It ensures consistent delivery of therapeutic agents across the skin barrier. In color cosmetics, it contributes to pigment dispersion and improves the texture of foundations and lip products. This results in a smoother application and more uniform color distribution for the end user. Isopropyl linoleate is supplied as a clear to pale yellow liquid. It is available in cosmetic-grade and pharmaceutical-grade specifications to meet the quality requirements of personal care and topical drug product manufacturers. Packaging typically ranges from drums to intermediate bulk containers depending on order volume.
